population: i.i.d. Uniform[1, 30] per cell on the F=50 grid (M=2500), row-major

entropy.tag: withheld in the public release; the entropy value above is unchanged

development_inputs: random_u1_30_seed1..10_F50 (C++ std::mt19937, used in Stages 1-7) are excluded from the sample; run with the same pipeline beforehand as a pilot and reported separately

budgets.target: B* = clamp(round((200 - mean(s0)) M / kappa), N, N Cmax); the C++ choice at B* is recorded and compared
budgets.grid: sorted(set(int(round(b)) for b in linspace(0.85 B*, 1.05 B*, 21))) (manuscript sweep)

lower_bound.primary: qp_audit: OSQP eps_abs = eps_rel = 1e-8 (manuscript setting), Lagrangian dual bound, range test 1e-10, fallback L = 0
lower_bound.check: Clarabel tol 1e-10 on every instance: relaxation objective P_c and Lagrangian bound L_c from its multipliers

candidates: paper largest-remainder rounding of the OSQP solution
C++ round->repair from the index-tie rounding
upper_bound.primary: U_rev = min over the feasible candidates of this run
upper_bound.paper: U_paper = min(greedy+repair, paper rounding) (manuscript Table S5 rule)
upper_bound.evaluator: V(x) = mean((A x + s0 - mean)^2) in Python for every candidate

statistics.T2: max over the 21-budget grid of 100 (U_rev - L_osqp) / U_rev (primary for budget-set claims)
statistics.summary: n, mean, median, Q1, Q3 (linear interpolation of order statistics), IQR, min, max

claim: For this population, model, budget grid and procedure, the sample maximum of T over 59 independent fields is a one-sided upper confidence bound at level 1 - 0.95^59 = 0.9515 for the population 95th percentile of T. It is not a worst-case guarantee over all fields, budgets or kernels and does not replace the numerical validity of each L.
reference_check: The manuscript abstract reports sampled sweep widths below 0.6% (4 fields). max T2_paper and max T2 are compared with 0.6% as an observation only; the procedure does not depend on it.
failure_rules: OSQP status other than solved, or the range test / fallback of qp_audit: L_osqp = 0 for that instance (width as computed, 100% when L = 0); the instance is kept.
Clarabel status other than Solved or its range test failing: L_c = 0 and no validity check for that instance.
C++ non-zero exit or missing allocation: rerun once; if it fails again the candidate is missing and U uses the remaining feasible candidates (paper rounding always exists).
Candidate with sum != B or outside [1, C_max]: discarded and recorded.
U <= 0: relative width undefined, recorded as +inf (worst) in order statistics; absolute width reported.
Validity flag: L_osqp or L_c > P_c + 1e-9 max(1, |P_c|) (P_c = Clarabel relaxation objective): counted and reported; L is not replaced.
Worker exception for a field: the whole field is rerun once; if it fails again T1 = T2 = +inf for it. The reported sample size is always 59.
No field, budget or instance is excluded; changes after registration are listed as deviations in the report.
threads: single-thread BLAS forced by determinism.py; 8 worker processes, one field each
